operators.name: conv2d_relu
semantics: Equivalent to torch.nn.functional.conv2d(input, weight, bias, stride, padding, dilation, groups) followed by torch.nn.functional.relu.
Bias is passed as given; if bias is None, no bias addition is performed.
Uses cuDNN for convolution and a custom elementwise ReLU kernel.
Output dimensions computed using standard Conv2d formula: floor((H + 2*padding - dilation*(kernel_size-1) -1)/stride + 1).
The ReLU is applied in-place on the convolution output before returning.

reference_steps.source: torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, self.conv2d.weight, bias=self.conv2d.bias, stride=self.conv2d.stride, padding=self.conv2d.padding, dilation=self.conv2d.dilation, groups=self.conv2d.groups)
semantics: Applies a 2D convolution with specified stride, padding, dilation, and groups.
Input x is [512, 3, 128, 128], weight [16, 3, 3, 3], bias [16], stride=1, padding=1, dilation=1, groups=1.
Applies ReLU activation elementwise to the convolution output.
Result tensor has same shape and dtype as convolution output.
